title: India's Doubles Pipeline: Who Follows Satwik-Chirag?
indian_angle: This article critically examines the future of Indian men's doubles beyond the top pair, a key concern for Indian badminton fans.
summary: Chief national coach Gopichand discusses the challenge of developing a strong doubles pipeline in India to bridge the gap between grassroots talent and the world's elite, following the success of Satwik-Chirag.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System for Indian Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change in domestic junior tournaments will affect how young Indian players compete and develop.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.

title: All India Senior Ranking Tournament Announced for Chennai
indian_angle: This circular announces a major domestic senior ranking tournament, crucial for Indian players to improve their national standings.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026 is scheduled to take place in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, from July 16th to 23rd.
